_README: Schema example for data/text_verdicts.json, which walk_hedge.py reads.
Every entry below is SYNTHETIC. The tickers, ids and reasons are invented to show the
shape of the file; none of them are real adjudications and none are the ones behind the
same_contract           Kalshi YES settles identically to Polymarket YES.
same_contract_inverted  Kalshi YES settles identically to Polymarket NO. The two venues
framed the question as complements, so the hedge sits on the
same nominal side of both books.
different_contract      Not the same instrument. Never walked.
unreadable              Published rule text is incomplete or templated. Fails closed.
walk_hedge.py only walks same_contract and same_contract_inverted. Anything else is
ignored, and an unrecognised verdict string is ignored rather than guessed at.
'why' is free text and is not parsed. Write down the settlement clause that decided it;
a verdict you cannot re-derive from the rule text six months later is not an audit trail.
Delete this _README key in your own file, or leave it: it is skipped because it is not a

KXEXAMPLECUM-27DEC31-T6|900000001.why: Kalshi asks 'at least 6 by 2027-12-31'; PM asks '5 or fewer by 2027-12-31'. Same count, same source, same deadline, complementary framing. Kalshi YES == PM NO.
KXEXAMPLECUM-27DEC31-T6|900000001.kalshi_title: Will there be at least 6 example events by Dec 31, 2027?

KXEXAMPLETHRESH-27JUN30|900000002.why: Both resolve on the same published figure, same release, same threshold direction, same cutoff timestamp. Rule text agrees clause by clause.
KXEXAMPLETHRESH-27JUN30|900000002.kalshi_title: Will the example index exceed 100 by Jun 30, 2027?

KXEXAMPLETEMP-26AUG20-B58|900000003.why: Titles both say the city name, but Kalshi settles on the airport station and PM settles on the downtown station. Different observations; the gap can exceed the bucket width.
KXEXAMPLETEMP-26AUG20-B58|900000003.kalshi_title: Highest temperature in Example City on Aug 20?
KXEXAMPLETEMP-26AUG20-B58|900000003.pm_title: Example City high temp on August 20?

KXEXAMPLEBUCKET-27MAR31-B58|900000004.why: Kalshi is an exclusive bucket (58.0-58.9). PM is cumulative (at least 58). PM still resolves YES at 59.0; Kalshi does not.

KXEXAMPLEPLACEHOLDER-27DEC31|900000005.why: Published Kalshi rule text is an unpopulated template: 'above || Count || by || Date || at || Time ||'. No external party can confirm the settlement terms, so this fails closed regardless of how well the title matches.
KXEXAMPLEPLACEHOLDER-27DEC31|900000005.kalshi_title: Will the example count exceed the threshold?
KXEXAMPLEPLACEHOLDER-27DEC31|900000005.pm_title: Example count above threshold by end of 2027?
